Urology, ENT, & GI recorded particularly strong organic growth of 21.0%, driven mainly by the aScope 4 portfolio and continued momentum for aScope 5 Uretero; growth also benefited from some orders typically expected in Q2.

verified_key_information_units.information: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring reported flat organic growth of -0.1%, impacted by extraordinarily high comparable revenue from Q1 2024/25.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring posted flat organic growth of -0.1% (17.8%), reflecting an extraordinarily high revenue achieved in the same quarter last year.

candidate_sentences.text: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring was broadly flat, with organic growth of -0.1% versus 17.8% last year, reflecting an exceptionally high prior-year revenue base.

verified_key_information_units.information: Geographic revenue growth varied significantly: North America +9.8%, Europe +9.7%, and Rest of World -1.6% due to order fluctuations and high prior-year comparables.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue growth was driven by solid organic growth in North America and Europe, respectively posting 9.8% (19.2%) and 9.7% (17.1%). Rest of World declined by -1.6% (28.0%), due to order fluctuations and high comparable revenue from last year.

candidate_sentences.text: North America and Europe grew organically by 9.8% and 9.7%, respectively, while Rest of World declined 1.6% because of order fluctuations and high comparables.

verified_key_information_units.information: Free cash flow before acquisitions was DKK 13m (down from DKK 69m), primarily due to increased net working capital, FX headwinds, and tariff costs.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Free cash flow (FCF) before acquisitions totaled DKK 13m (DKK 69m). This was mainly negatively impacted by a change in net working capital... FCF was also impacted by both FX headwind and tariff costs.

candidate_sentences.text: Operating cash flow declined to DKK 106m from DKK 144m, and free cash flow before acquisitions fell to DKK 13m from DKK 69m.
The main drag was an adverse DKK 107m change in working capital, as inventories and working capital remained elevated to support growth and mitigate geopolitical uncertainties.

verified_key_information_units.information: DKK 90m dividend was paid per share (DKK 0.41) and DKK 38m was used to acquire treasury shares as part of the Q1 share buyback program.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Ambu paid out DKK 90m in dividend in Q1, corresponding to DKK 0.41 per share. In addition, DKK 38m was used to acquire treasury shares in Q1 as part of Ambu’s share buyback program.

candidate_sentences.text: Ambu paid DKK 110m in dividends and repurchased DKK 38m of treasury shares during the quarter.

verified_key_information_units.information: The portable SureSight Mobile video laryngoscope was launched, expanding Ambu’s video laryngoscope portfolio for pre-hospital and hospital intubation settings.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Introduction of Ambu’s portable video laryngoscope solution, SureSight Mobile, expanding Ambu’s video laryngoscope portfolio and Respiratory offering. The solution enables clinicians to perform emergent intubations swiftly in demanding environments.

candidate_sentences.text: Respiratory grew organically by 8.3%, supported by continued adoption of aScope 5 Broncho and the launch of the SureSight video laryngoscope solution.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Ambu Recircle Program was extended to include collection and recycling of blades from the SureSight video laryngoscopy solution, planned for 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Extension of the Ambu Recircle Program to include the collection and recycling of blades from Ambu’s video laryngoscopy solution, Ambu SureSight Connect, in 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: Full-year 2025/26 financial guidance was maintained: organic revenue growth of 10-13% and EBIT margin before special items of 12-14% (14-16% excluding tariff impacts).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: The 2025/26 financial guidance is maintained... Organic revenue growth: 10-13%... EBIT margin b.s.i.: 12-14%... 14-16% excluding assumed impacts of ~2%-pts given the current schedule of expected tariffs.

candidate_sentences.text: The company maintained its full-year guidance for 10–13% organic revenue growth, a 12–14% EBIT margin before special items, and cash conversion above 40%.

Growth and margin are expected to be higher in the second half of the financial year, while tariffs are expected to reduce the EBIT margin by approximately two percentage points under current assumptions.

verified_key_information_units.information: Sustainability milestones included operationalization of the Ambu Recircle Program across four markets and production of the first batch of recycled material from endoscopes.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Ambu continues to advance its recycling program, which now operates in four markets... A key Q1 milestone was the production of the first batch of recycled material derived from collected endoscopes.

details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers most HIGH importance criteria (K1-K8, K10), representing organic revenue growth, EBIT performance, regional growth, cash flow, dividend/share buyback, and product launches. However, it omits the Ambu Recircle Program extension (K9) and sustainability milestones (K11), both of which are explicitly required. The omissions are material for K9 (a specific program extension) and K11 (sustainability progress), but the core financial and operational picture is well captured, justifying a 'Generally yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support each other without contradictions. The structure follows a clear progression from revenue performance to profitability, cash flow, and guidance. Explanations for variances (e.g., foreign exchange impacts, high comparables, tariff costs) are consistent throughout. There is no unnecessary repetition, and related information is grouped appropriately (e.g., regional performance in S7, margin analysis in S9-S11). The summary forms a logical narrative from top-line growth to bottom-line performance and outlook.
